CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListQualify

Returns a list in which each element is surrounded by a qualifier string, for example single quotes. You can qualify every element or only the ones that are not numbers.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListQualify(list, qualifier [, delimiters ] [, elements ])

Parameters

list
The list.
qualifier
The string to put before and after each element, for example "'".
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma. The first character separates the elements of the result.
elements
Optional. ALL (the default) qualifies every element; CHAR qualifies only elements that are not numbers.

Returns

The qualified list.

Usage

The classic use is building a SQL IN clause from a list of strings, as the example shows. Remember that CFQUERY doubles single quotes inside variables; wrap the result in PreserveSingleQuotes to send the quotes through unchanged.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Wanted = "Sales,Training">
<CFSET InList = ListQualify(Wanted, "'")>
<CFQUERY NAME="GetPeople" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Department FROM Employees
WHERE Department IN (#PreserveSingleQuotes(InList)#)
ORDER BY Department, LastName
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>IN clause: (#InList#)</P>
<P>Only the text elements: #ListQualify("Joe,42,Jane,3.14", """", ",", "CHAR")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetPeople">
<TR><TD>#Department#</TD><TD>#FirstName# #LastName#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
